**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include precision prompts in the configuration fingerprint**

For `--quality` campaigns, the effective configuration includes the separately composed precision prompts, but this fingerprint hashes only `buildRecallPrompt`. If precision-specific prompt construction changes between the separately executed sweep-off and sweep-on legs while the recall prompt remains unchanged, both records retain the same fingerprint and can incorrectly appear identical apart from `sweepMode`. Hash every prompt issued by the run, preferably as per-request fingerprints, so the precision comparison can actually detect configuration drift.
